headline: Tabulation of vote-by-mail ballots postmarked by November 3 and received by November 6.
summary: Vote-by-mail ballots will be removed, deposited, and tabulated. The ballots include those dropped off by 8:00 p.m. on November 3 and those postmarked by November 3 and received by 5:00 p.m. on November 6.
items: Remove, deposit, and tabulate vote-by-mail ballots
Ballots deposited in drop boxes or delivered to the City Clerk's Office on Tuesday, November 3, before 8:00 p.m.
Ballots postmarked on or before November 3 and received by the City Clerk's Office by 5:00 p.m. on Friday, November 6
Processing and counting continue until complete
location: Herbert L. Jackson Council Chamber, 215 Pleasant Street

NOTICE OF POST-ELECTION TABULATION OF VOTE BY MAIL BALLOTS 
POSTMARKED BY NOVEMBER 3RD & 
RECEIVED BY NOVEMBER 6TH AT 5:00 P.M. 
 
In accordance with the Secretary of State’s Regulations and under the provisions of Massachusetts General Laws 
Chapter 54 Section 25b, the City of Malden will be removing, depositing, and tabulating Vote by Mail ballots at 9:00 
a.m. on Saturday, November 7, 2026, in the Herbert L. Jackson Council Chamber, 215 Pleasant Street. 
 
Vote by Mail Ballots to be removed, deposited, and tabulated at this session include: 
➢ All Vote by Mail ballots deposited in drop boxes or delivered to the City Clerk’s Office on Tuesday, 
November 3rd prior to 8:00 P.M.; and 
➢ All Vote by Mail ballots posted-marked on or before November 3rd and received in the City Clerk’s 
Office by 5:00 p.m. on Friday, November 6th. 
 
Processing and counting will continue until complete.  
 
 
選舉後郵寄投票選票點算公告 
郵戳日期須為 11 月 3 日或之前，並須於  
11 月 6 日下午 5:00 前收到 
 
根據麻州州務卿的相關規定，以及《麻州普通法》第 54 章第 25B 條，摩頓市將於 2026 年 11 月 7 日（
星期六) 上午 9:00，在 伯特·傑克遜（Herbert L. Jackson) 市議會議事廳 (Council Chamber) ，215 派臣街（
Pleasant Street) ，進行郵寄投票選票的取出、放入點票機及票數統計工作。 
 
本次將進行取出、放入點票機及票數統計的郵寄投票選票包括： 
• 所有於 11 月 3 日（星期二）晚上 8:00 前投入選票收集箱，或送達市書記官辦公室（
City Clerk’s Office）的郵寄投票選票 
• 所有郵戳日期為 11 月 3 日或之前，並於 11 月 6 日 (星期五) 下午 5:00 前由市書記官辦公室收到
的郵寄投票選票 
 
選票處理及點算工作將持續進行，直至全部完成。
